verdict.rationale: cubic supports some breadth-scale automation — codebase scans that 'deploy thousands of AI agents' across a repository (cubic-docs-12) and custom agents/rules enforced 'across pull requests' (cubic-docs-9) — but there's no documented user-facing bulk action (e.g., batch-reviewing many PRs/repos on demand, bulk-approve/bulk-fix across items) beyond automatic per-PR review. Missing for 10: explicit bulk/batch operation API or UI for acting on many PRs or repos simultaneously, and independent evidence of this working at scale.
